title: 50agents vs Glide: AI app builders compared | 50agents
description: 50agents vs Glide: Glide builds internal apps from spreadsheets and prompts, $25 a month to publish; 50agents builds apps run by AI agents, free to start.
answer: Pick Glide for business apps from spreadsheets, published to a phone's home screen.
Pick 50agents when the app is one part of the work, with AI agents that follow up for you.
line: Apps that are one part of the work, with AI agents that follow up.
ask: Track my leads and follow up
lede: Two app builders, row by row.

strengths.title: Apps with your own records
strengths.line: Lists, boards and tables, run by a crew of AI agents.

strengths.title: AI agents that decide
strengths.line: Each run, an AI agent works from your instructions and connected apps.

strengths.title: You approve what goes out
strengths.line: Emails to clients wait in Needs you until you say yes.

move.title: Export your table
move.body: Any Glide table exports to CSV.

move.title: Ask for a leads app
move.body: Say "track my leads and follow up" and drop in the CSV.

move.title: Approve the follow-ups
move.body: Each email to a lead waits in Needs you.

faqs.a: You can build on Glide Free, but publishing an app or enabling a workflow needs a paid plan. Basic is $25 a month.
Yes. A 50agents app can serve people outside your team, on your own domain. Glide has public apps from Plus.
Glide works with more than 1,000 services. 50agents works with 2,300+ apps through viaSocket.
50agents is free to start. Glide's Basic plan is $25 a month and Plus is $50 a month.

faqs.q: Can I move my Glide data into 50agents?
faqs.a: Any table in a Glide project exports to CSV. In 50agents, drop a CSV or Excel file into an app and Captain matches the columns.

faqs.q: Which suits an app built from a spreadsheet?
faqs.a: GlideOS builds internal apps from spreadsheets, prompts or files. In 50agents you tell Captain what you need, and AI agents run the app.
Yes. Automations run the same steps on an event or a schedule. Glide has Workflows on paid plans.
